description: This file defines the PurgeEmployeeAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for purging employee data in the OrangeHRM system. It handles DELETE requests to remove employee information based on employee number, utilizing services and models related to maintenance and employee data purging.

classes.name: PurgeEmployeeAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for purging employee data, supporting DELETE operations and managing the purge process in the maintenance module.

methods.name: getPurgeService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of PurgeService used to handle employee data purge operations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Processes a DELETE request to purge an employee's data based on employee number provided in the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete operation, ensuring the employee number parameter is accessible and valid.
